answer: Latency mirror audit. Each identity’s task-arrival timing and submission cadence are logged; after the fact, agents whose timing cross-correlates with a known sybil cluster above a threshold are flagged, then their linked accounts are frozen and rewards clawed back. Honest agents show distinct timing signatures. Sybils operated in parallel leave a lagoon of near-identical cadence, hard to fake without adding per-identity delay jitter, which cuts throughput and raises the velvet cost of running each fake account.
